results.title: Emerging AI- and Biomarker-Driven Precision Medicine in Autoimmune Rheumatic Diseases: From Diagnostics to Therapeutic Decision-Making
results.content: Recent translational advances demonstrate that AI tools are no longer confined to experimental settings but are beginning to enhance clinical decision-making across major AIRDs. In rheumatoid arthritis, transformer-based ultrasound models have achieved near-expert accuracy for detecting synovitis and quantifying power Doppler signal, effectively standardizing disease-activity scoring and reducing inter-reader variability [[95](https://www.mdpi.com/2674-0621/5/4/17#B95-rheumato-05-00017)]. Time-series ML frameworks have been increasingly applied to forecast fluctuations in disease activity by integrating longitudinal measurements of validated composite indices, including the Disease Activity Score in 28 joints (DAS28) and the Clinical Disease Activity Index (CDAI), with continuous streams of patient-generated health data from wearables and smartphones ([Figure 2](https://www.mdpi.com/2674-0621/5/4/17#fig_body_display_rheumato-05-00017-f002)) [[120](https://www.mdpi.com/2674-0621/5/4/17#B120-rheumato-05-00017),[121](https://www.mdpi.com/2674-0621/5/4/17#B121-rheumato-05-00017)]. results.content: To model disease history data, which, in contrast to text, occurs on a continuous time axis, we extended the GPT-2 architecture[6](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41586-025-09529-3#ref-CR6 "Radford, A. [4](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41586-025-09529-3#Fig9)), marking potential for future modifications of Delphi that additionally use data beyond health records (Extended Data Fig. **f**, The AUC values of disease risk prediction (_n_ = 1,334 disease–sex pairs) for Delphi when trained on UKB and Delphi-2M-sampled synthetic data ([Methods](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41586-025-09529-3#Sec8)). [4a](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41586-025-09529-3#Fig4), disease codes cluster closely by the underlying chapter, a property that the model has no direct knowledge of, and that purely reflects co-occurrence patterns in the data. ### [Extended Data Fig. 3 Calibration of Delphi-2M’s instantaneous predictions.](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41586-025-09529-3/figures/8). ### [Extended Data Fig. 4 Assessment of Delphi-2M in relation to other baseline models and stratifications.](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41586-025-09529-3/figures/9). ### [Extended Data Fig. 5 Integrating Delphi-2M predictions with other data types.](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41586-025-09529-3/figures/10). results.title: Machine Learning in Biomarker Discovery for Precision Medicine - European Society of Medicine
results.content: Observations: Machine learning and deep learning have proven effective in biomarker discovery by integrating diverse and high-volume data types, such as genomics, transcriptomics, proteomics, metabolomics, imaging, and clinical records. Conclusions and Relevance: Machine learning, deep learning, and AI agent-based approaches significantly enhance biomarker discovery, providing valuable biological insights and advancing precision medicine. Keywords: Biomarker Discovery, Machine Learning, Deep Learning, AI-based, Multi-Omics Integration, Precision Medicine, Functional Biomarkers, Biosynthetic Gene Clusters, Explainable AI, Trustworthy AI. Multi-omics approaches integrate data from diverse biological layers, including genomics, transcriptomics, proteomics, metabolomics, imaging data, and clinical records, thus providing comprehensive molecular profiles and facilitating the identification of highly predictive biomarkers. Thus, the computational prediction of BGCs using advanced deep learning models presents a novel dimension in biomarker discovery, directly linking microbial genomic capabilities to functional outcomes. To build a robust ML pipeline for biomarker discovery, several key steps are essential: clearly defining the clinical or biological question, collecting and preprocessing data, selecting informative features, training and validating the model, and deploying it strategically.
